part:top_shell.title: Top shell
part:top_shell.desc: One molded shell: back, brow and the two leaf ears. Mic port; copper-foil touch pad inside. 4 screws to the chassis.

part:chassis.title: Chassis
part:chassis.desc: The structural tub: four servo towers, battery cradle, PCB standoffs, speaker grille, cliff windows, tail socket. Everything mounts to this one part.

part:visor.title: Face visor
part:visor.desc: Smoked polycarbonate window over the eyes, camera and ToF. IR-transparent ink patch over the ToF.

part:tail.title: Tail (charging plug)
part:tail.desc: Soft TPU tail overmolded on a 2-wire harness. Its tip holds the charging pads: Nibbo backs into its bed and plugs in with its tail.

part:thigh_fl.title: Thigh
part:thigh_fl.desc: Same part on all four legs (symmetric). Bolts to the hip horn; the knee pushrod runs along its back edge. Glass-filled nylon.

part:shin_fl.title: Shin
part:shin_fl.desc: Same part on all four legs. Tapered blade, crank above the knee for the pushrod, TPU foot ball overmolded (2-shot).

part:foot_fl.title: Foot ball (TPU overmold)
part:foot_fl.desc: Grippy, quiet 15 mm TPU ball molded onto the shin: no slipping on wood floors, no clicking.

part:pushrod_fl.title: Knee pushrod
part:pushrod_fl.desc: 1:1 link from the knee servo horn (in the body) to the shin crank, so the knee servo lives in the body instead of the leg.

part:bed.title: Charging bed
part:bed.desc: Oval bed Nibbo walks into and lies down in. Raised back holds the spring contacts and IR beacon; USB-C at the back.

elec:servo_hip_fl.title: Hip servo (MG92B-class)
elec:servo_hip_fl.desc: MG92B-class metal-gear micro servo, 3.5 kg-cm (0.34 N-m) stall at 6 V, 0.08 s/60 deg, 13.8 g. Production version ordered with a 4th wire on the potentiometer wiper so the ESP32 reads joint angle. Peak need is 0.15 N-m (self-righting), trot needs about 0.1 N-m: see docs/TORQUE.md.

elec:servo_knee_fl.title: Knee servo (MG92B-class)
elec:servo_knee_fl.desc: Same servo as the hips (one part number for all 8). Drives the shin through a 1:1 horn/pushrod/crank, so the leg stays slim and the servo mass sits in the body.

elec:horn_hip_fl.title: Hip horn (round, 20T)
elec:horn_hip_fl.desc: Aluminium round horn that comes with the servo; 4 x M2 screws into the thigh.

elec:horn_knee_fl.title: Knee horn + standoff
elec:horn_knee_fl.desc: 12 mm single-arm horn on a 3.5 mm standoff, M2 shoulder pin to the pushrod.

elec:battery.title: 2S Li-ion pack, 2 x 18650 (7.2 V, 2500 mAh)
elec:battery.desc: 18 Wh with protection IC on the main board. Lying low along the belly between the four servo towers keeps the centre of mass low and central. Estimated 60-90 min of active play, ~8 h of watching/idling.

elec:pcb.title: Main board (4-layer, 42 x 56 mm)
elec:pcb.desc: One board does everything: ESP32-S3 module, 8 servo outputs with angle feedback, 2S charger (IP2326), protection, 6 V / 5 A servo buck, 3.3 V rail, I2S amp, IMU, mic, touch inputs. No USB port: charges through the tail, updates over Wi-Fi, factory-programmed on test pads.

elec:esp32.title: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8
elec:esp32.desc: Dual-core 240 MHz, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi + BLE (pre-certified module). Runs the gait, the face, wake-word and person/pet detection (ESP-DL), and streams the camera to the phone app.

elec:imu.title: IMU (ICM-42670-P)
elec:imu.desc: 6-axis IMU: balance, fall detection, "pick-up" and petting gestures.

elec:amp.title: I2S amp (MAX98357A)
elec:amp.desc: 3 W class-D amp for the voice/chirp speaker.

elec:charger.title: 2S charger IC (IP2326)
elec:charger.desc: Boost-charges the 2S pack from 5 V at the bed contacts, with balancing.

elec:buck.title: 6 V / 5 A servo buck + inductor
elec:buck.desc: Synchronous buck from the 2S pack to 6 V for the servos (full MG92B torque).

elec:mic.title: MEMS microphone (I2S)
elec:mic.desc: Hears its name, claps and the wake word; port hole in the top shell above.

elec:lcd.title: 1.47" IPS face display (172 x 320, ST7789)
elec:lcd.desc: Landscape behind the smoked visor: draws the two eyes, blinks, moods, and icons (timer, weather, battery). The whole personality lives here.

elec:camera.title: Camera, OV2640 160 deg wide (DVP)
elec:camera.desc: Sees people, pets, the bed marker and obstacles. Wide lens so the home check-in view covers a room from floor height.

elec:tof.title: ToF distance sensor (VL53L1X)
elec:tof.desc: 4 m laser ranging through an IR window in the visor: obstacle stop + "come here" approach distance.

elec:cliff_l.title: Cliff sensor (IR reflective)
elec:cliff_l.desc: Downward IR pair behind each front window: stops Nibbo at table and stair edges.

elec:cliff_r.title: Cliff sensor (IR reflective)
elec:cliff_r.desc: Downward IR pair behind each front window: stops Nibbo at table and stair edges.

elec:speaker.title: Speaker 20 mm, 8 ohm 1 W
elec:speaker.desc: Faces down through the belly grille; the floor reflects the sound out. Chirps, purrs and speaks reminders.

elec:touch.title: Touch pad (copper foil on shell inside)
elec:touch.desc: ESP32 capacitive touch on the back: pet it and it leans in, purrs and its eyes go soft.

elec:tailpad_l.title: Tail charging contacts (gold pads)
elec:tailpad_l.desc: Two gold-plated pads in the tail tip. Nibbo backs into its bed and the tail lands on the bed's spring contacts.

elec:tailpad_r.title: Tail charging contacts (gold pads)
elec:tailpad_r.desc: Two gold-plated pads in the tail tip. Nibbo backs into its bed and the tail lands on the bed's spring contacts.

elec:bed_pcb.title: Bed board: USB-C in + IR beacon
elec:bed_pcb.desc: USB-C 5 V in, two spring contacts at tail-tip height, and a modulated IR LED beacon Nibbo homes on when its battery is low.

elec:bed_pin_l.title: Bed spring contacts
elec:bed_pin_l.desc: Spring-loaded pogo contacts (5 mm travel) that meet the tail pads.

elec:bed_pin_r.title: Bed spring contacts
elec:bed_pin_r.desc: Spring-loaded pogo contacts (5 mm travel) that meet the tail pads.

elec:bed_ir.title: IR beacon LED
elec:bed_ir.desc: 940 nm LED, coded so Nibbo can tell its bed from a TV remote.
